title: Church Mission
definition: Church Mission is the calling of the Church to glorify God by making disciples, proclaiming Christ, and displaying the Gospel in word and deed.
summary: Church Mission is the Church's calling to glorify God by making Christ known, forming disciples, and displaying the Gospel.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His people as witnesses to His death, resurrection, lordship, and grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine addresses the Church's purpose in the world. The Church does not exist merely to preserve itself; it is sent as a witness to Christ's kingdom. Mission includes evangelism, discipleship, mercy, holiness, worship, and faithful presence among the nations and neighbors.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because churches can become inward, distracted, or survival-focused. Mission keeps the congregation aligned with the heart of Christ for the lost and the growth of His people. It also helps every ministry ask whether it serves the Gospel purpose of the Church.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray that your church's schedule, budget, teaching, and care serve Christ's mission. Personally participate through witness, discipleship, giving, prayer, and hospitality. Refuse to let comfort become the church's mission.
